basic_details.job_title: IIT Gandhinagar Program Associate-I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (IIT Gandhinagar) has notified 1 temporary vacancy for the Program Associate-I (Grants Management) post under its 2026 recruitment. The appointment is for a tenure of 1 year, with renewal based on performance, and the notified pay is Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 80,000 per month based on experience. Candidates applying for the post must possess the prescribed qualification and meet the minimum percentage criteria specified in the official notification. Eligible applicants can submit their application through the online recruitment link on or before the last date

how_to_apply: Visit the official project staff recruitment portal.
Submit the application online via the provided link before the last date of 31.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Program Associate-I at a Glance

rows.details: Rs. 45,000/- to Rs. 80,000/- per month (Based on experience)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential Qualifications: B.Tech./B.E./M.Sc./M.C.A./LLM./CA/CMA/CS/MBA/Professional qualification or equivalent in an appropriate discipline. OR B.C.A./B.Sc./B.A./B.Com./B.B.A./LLB. or equivalent qualification in an appropriate discipline with a minimum of 04 years of post-qualification experience. Academic Percentage Criteria: A minimum of 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards, and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th. Desirable Qualifications: Proven communication skills, strong time management and interpersonal skills Initiative, enthusiasm and a flexible approach to work The ability to analyze, summarize and communicate information The ability to work both independently and as part of a team

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Gandhinagar Program Associate-I
content_sections.text: Visit the official project staff recruitment portal. Submit the application online via the provided link before the last date of 31.10.2026. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

faq.question: Q1. Is this a permanent position or on contract?
faq.answer: The position is temporary for a duration of 1 year, and renewal will be based on the performance of the selected candidate.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational requirement for this position?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a B.Tech., B.E., M.Sc., M.C.A., LLM, CA, CMA, CS, MBA, or equivalent professional qualification, OR a B.C.A., B.Sc., B.A., B.Com., B.B.A., LLB, or equivalent qualification with a minimum of 4 years of post-qualification experience, along with at least 60% marks from graduation onwards and 55% in class 10th and 12th.

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly remuneration offered?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration ranges from Rs. 45,000/- to Rs. 80,000/- per month, depending on the experience of the selected candidate.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for application submission is 31.10.2026.

faq.question: Q5. Where can candidates apply online?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official recruitment link at http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/.
